FINAL SQL:
SELECT d.name
FROM Dogs d
JOIN (
    SELECT o.owner_id, COALESCE(SUM(t.cost_of_treatment), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM Owners o
    LEFT JOIN Dogs dg ON dg.owner_id = o.owner_id
    LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON t.dog_id = dg.dog_id
    GROUP BY o.owner_id
) os ON os.owner_id = d.owner_id
WHERE os.total_spent <= 1000;
